description: PAID MCP TOOL — $0.079 USDC per successful call via native x402. Discovery is free. Stock price reaction to past earnings events for any US equity. Returns report-day and next-day price move % for each recent quarterly earnings date, paired with the EPS beat/miss magnitude and reaction class (beat_and_up, beat_selloff, miss_and_down, miss_rally, neutral). Identifies contrarian signals where price moved opposite to the EPS surprise. Pairs with earnings-calendar (upcoming dates) and earnings-surprises (EPS history). Yahoo Finance, no API key.
